=={{Anchor|Fishing Maps}}{{CC|Fishing}}==
These maps show the locations of certain [[SR:Fishing Supplies|Fishing Supplies]] within a given region, but are not required in order to fish there. They can usually be bought from [[Skyrim:Merchants|general merchants]].
